summary: Backend-only testing for Delivery Hub MVP. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest) covering: super_admin login + JWT/user shape, /api/admin/stats, admin company create (with owner user), list, license renewal (add_days extends license and preserves plan), active toggle (deactivate hides from /api/stores and blocks orders with 400, /api/stores/{id} returns 404), company owner login (role=company, company_id set), /api/company/me + stats, product CRUD (create/list/update/delete), customer registration, public /api/stores (with segment=food filter), /api/stores/{id} and /api/stores/{id}/products, order placement (verified subtotal 85.0 + delivery_fee 5.5 = total 90.5 and whatsapp propagated), /api/orders/me, /api/company/orders + status update, authorization enforcement (customer→admin=403, customer→company=403, company→admin=403, missing token=401). All 29/29 tests PASSED. License-expired (past date) not directly tested since backend has no endpoint to set past expiration; instead the equivalent enforcement path (active=false) was verified end-to-end, which uses the same company_license_valid() guard as expiration.

minor.issue: Returns 200 on creation instead of 201 Created (convention only, not blocking).

In list_stores(), companies without license_expires_at are silently dropped (only items where fromisoformat > now are appended). All admin-created companies have the field, so it works, but manually inserted docs would disappear.

action_items: Optional: expose an admin helper to force-expire a license (or accept negative add_days) so the expired-license path can be regression-tested via API. Current active=false path already exercises the same guard.
Optional: return 201 for POST /api/admin/companies and POST /api/company/products, and 204 for DELETEs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py current_user swallows the specific JWT error and always returns 'Invalid or expired token' — acceptable, but consider logging the exception for debugging.
list_stores skips companies where license_expires_at is missing or unparseable; consider treating missing as invalid explicitly or defaulting on creation (creation already always sets it, so fine).
clean() mutates the input dict; callers pass dict(user) copies, which is correct — leave a note or refactor to return a new dict for safety.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed companies/products/users/orders and clean them up at the end (delete product + delete company cascades users/products). No leftover data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; it is idempotent and self-cleans. BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env var (frontend/.env). Super admin creds: admin@delivery.com / Admin@12345.
rca_of_issue: No issues found — all backend endpoints behave per spec.
